'''Sechel's secret apartment''' was the secret apartment of [[Sechel]], [[Darth Nyriss]]' [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]. In [[3950 BBY]] Sechel was ambushed in his secret apartment by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] for the files [[Gender/Legends|he]] had on the [[Nathema conspiracy]]. After acquiring the files the Sith Lord [[Death/Legends|killed]] Sechel.<ref name="Revan" />
